answer.feedback: All three candidates show severe lack of fit. Revisit the process model, not just the growth-rate law: in E3 late (worst at 20 h), the models underpredict both glucose and biomass; in E2 they also underpredict glucose (worst at 4–7 h). Consider a mechanism or balance that permits more biomass while leaving more glucose, such as a higher or variable biomass yield (lower glucose uptake per biomass formed), and check the feed/dilution and substrate-balance assumptions. Test whether it also explains the earlier E2 glucose discrepancy.
answer.reasoning: None qualifies because each chi-square is far above its 95% limit. C9 and C40 have nearly identical lack-of-fit patterns; C40 also has an uninformative Ki estimate, while C8 fits worse. The data therefore call for another search rather than acceptance.
